title: Writing a Formal Email
text:
A formal email is written to a teacher, a manager or a company. It starts with a polite greeting, such as 'Dear Mr. Smith'. The first sentence should explain why you are writing.

The message should be short and clear. Use full sentences and polite words, such as 'please' and 'thank you'. End with a closing like 'Kind regards' and your name.

questions.text: What does a formal email start with?
options: A polite greeting, such as 'Dear Mr. Smith'
With a closing like 'Kind regards' and your name

questions.text: Why should the first sentence explain why you are writing?
options: So the reader knows the purpose quickly
To hide the reason for the email

questions.text: What tone does the writer want the email to have?

vocabulary.definition: words you say or write when you first meet or contact someone
the final words before your name at the end of a letter or email

paragraph_translations: Um e-mail formal é escrito para um professor, um gerente ou uma empresa. Ele começa com uma saudação educada, como 'Dear Mr. Smith'. A primeira frase deve explicar por que você está escrevendo.
A mensagem deve ser curta e clara. Use frases completas e palavras educadas, como 'please' e 'thank you'. Termine com uma despedida, como 'Kind regards', e com o seu nome.
